g.text: Figure 3 — UML Component diagram — application components and interfaces
UML Component diagram: components and provided/required interfaces show structural
dependencies. GoF Adapter labels identify boundary translation roles; Strategy seams
identify ports with interchangeable implementations; the analysis application service
acts as a Facade over orchestration. Structural presence does not imply first acceptance:
authentication is activated with the MUST_HAVE ring, not the mandatory R1 slice.
